comments.author: @desiv1170
comments.text:
"I still don't have any dental insurance..."
I wouldn't worry about that.  
I mean, I have it and it's great for a free cleaning.
But things like actual dental work?  It won't save you that much.
I had a crown done recently.  Over $1,100 for me.  The insurance covered $150.   Wow....
And yeah, I'm lucky for that, but...  
Have you considered dental tourism?  I haven't done that yet myself, but I hear you can save a LOT of money that way.  
So, if you can't afford a vacation because of dental work, take the vacation and get the dental work there for less money than the dental work will cost you here, with insurance.
Fun place we live in!  (And I love where I live, but..)
